summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the admission of 612,740 ordinary shares to the London Stock Exchange under a block admission announced on 25 March 2026. This is a routine administrative notification of share issuance, not a special situation. The shares rank pari passu with existing shares, and no prospectus is applicable. No deal terms, board recommendation, or strategic event is involved. This is ordinary equity issuance activity, and no special-situation classification applies.
